registry_scope: Partially populated. The Tier 2B intake ticket (plans/dev_graph_demo_tickets.md, branch dev_graph_demo) registered the three sources for topic HORIZON-CL6-2027-01-BIODIV-01. The Tier 1 and Tier 2A RIA coverage-check ticket adds the three call-neutral sources it cites: the 2026-2027 General Annexes and the RIA/IA application and evaluation forms. Still unregistered: the remaining Tier 1 legislation, programme guidance and grant-architecture documents, the non-RIA Tier 2A forms, and the other Tier 2B work programmes. Each is the scope of its own ticket. CLAUDE.md §9.6 requires the registry to reflect repository state; this entry records how far it does, so a reader is not misled into treating an absent path as an absent document.
entry_schema: Required on every entry: document_id, path (repo-relative POSIX), tier, media_type, bytes, sha256, digest_basis, title, role, retrieved_on, registered_by. Optional: retrieved_from (absent when the document predates this branch and its retrieval is unrecorded), retrieval_note (why retrieved_from is absent and what basis retrieved_on rests on, required whenever retrieved_from is absent), pages (paginated documents only). bytes and sha256 are measured on the digest_basis, not on the raw file: raw_bytes for a binary document, lf_normalised_bytes for a text one. Text documents are normalised because core.autocrlf is true in this repository, so a text file checks out CRLF on Windows and LF elsewhere, and a raw digest would identify the platform rather than the content.
